Name: Lnh's Whale Ridge Farmhouse
Author: liunianhui
Description:
[center][color=#ffff00][size=4][b]一个新的海边农舍，它的名字叫做鲸鱼山脊农舍。[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#ffff00][size=4][b]这里可以种植作物，地图是温室属性，有季节性变化，有一个猫爪温泉，可以回复体力。[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#ffff00][size=4][b]A new seaside farmhouse named Whale Ridge Farmhouse.[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#ffff00][size=4][b]Crops can be grown here, and the map shows greenhouse, properties with seasonal variations. There is also a cat paw hot spring that can restore energy.[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=4][b][color=#ffff00]有3个版本可供选择：1.替换原版农舍，2.PIF版本，3.找罗宾建造，3个版本可以一起安装。
There are 3 versions to choose from: 1. Replace Vanilla Farmhouse, 2. PIF version, 3. Buildable with Robin, 3 versions can be installed together.[/color]

[color=#f4cccc]已知bug：
1. 替换版本每当换季第一天时，酒窖入口和配偶房间家具可能会消失，重新启动一次游戏即可恢复。
2. 找罗宾建造的版本，鱼类出现的水域错乱，经过多次尝试，无法修复。
Known bugs:
1.Replaced version On the first day of each season, the wine cellar entrance and spouse room furniture may disappear, but reopening the game can restore them.
2.The buildable version has caused confusion in the water where fish appear, but after multiple attempts, it cannot be repaired.[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#ff0000][size=4][b]替换版本的注意事项：[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#ff0000][size=4][b]安装或者卸载或者升级农舍前，需要清空农舍内的所有物品（包括家具，制作物品，作物等等）[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#ff0000][size=4][b]开局需要手动挪一下床。[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#ff0000][size=4][b]Notes on Replaced version：[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#ff0000][size=4][b]Before installing, uninstalling, or upgrading the farmhouse, it is necessary to clear all items inside the farmhouse (including furniture, crafting items, crops, etc.)[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[center][size=4][b][color=#ff0000]The new game requires you to move the bed by yourself.[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=4][b][color=#00ff00]兼容多配偶方法：
1. 首先安装多配偶mod，[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20599]PolyamorySweet[/url]
2. 在可选文件中下载PolyamorySweetRooms文件，解压，会得到一个名为 PolyamorySweetRooms的文件夹，Ctrl+C复制该文件夹。
3. 打开多配偶mod文件夹，Ctrl+V把刚刚复制的文件夹粘贴进来，选择替换。
Compatible with PolyamorySweet method：
1. First install 
2. Download the PolyamorySweetRooms file from the optional files,  decompress,  You will receive a folder named PolyamorySweetRooms,  Ctrl+C Copy this folder.
3. Open the PolyamorySweet mod folder,  Ctrl+V paste the folder you just copied into it,  Choose replacement.[/color]
